findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present during inspection. Discussed with PIC, PIC is in the process of acquiring food managers license. Ensure a certified food manager is present during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed multiple dishes to be resting in hand sink. Discussed with PIC, ensure hand sink is solely being used for hand washing. Dished were removed from hand sink.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking behind the kitchen sinks to be cracked. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
